candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The second consumes that capsule, reopens only anchor_policy and anchor_contract, and emits one complete executable policy state. The final call consumes that state, simultaneously reopens task_constraints, loop_structure, task, and candidate_hypothesis, reconciles their joint implications in the inherited artifact, and emits one policy.
candidate_structure.name: Terminally Contracted Reentry Relay
candidate_structure.organization: three-call sequential lineage preserving one complete executable artifact while contracting the two terminal evidence windows into one co-visible transition

calls.objective: Reconcile the initially visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact.

Consume originate_executable_capsule, expose the inherited artifact to the reentered anchor evidence and contract obligations, reconcile visible conflicts directly in that artifact, and emit one complete executable policy state.

Consume anchor_window_transition, expose the inherited complete artifact simultaneously to the reentered constraints, structural evidence, task, and hypothesis, reconcile their joint obligations in that artifact, and emit one complete policy.

mode_certificate.scope_boundary: Only the edge between the constraint-window transition and terminal task-hypothesis transition is contracted; the single lineage, anchor reentry, complete executable artifacts, and sole final policy emission remain unchanged.
mode_certificate.why_not_repeat_role_fission: This mutation merges two causal transitions and reduces the lineage from four calls to three; it creates no duplicated producer, reviewer, finalizer, gate, or terminal role.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Contract the terminal lineage edge by fusing the constraint window and task-hypothesis window into one terminal transition with simultaneous visibility of both evidence groups.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: A single causally authoritative terminal reconciliation should reduce avoidable artifact churn while preserving a complete executable lineage.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion fixes constraint and structural reconciliation before task and hypothesis evidence reenter, so cross-window conflicts can trigger consecutive revisions of the same executable artifact.

structural_mutation.after: A three-call lineage contracts those two transitions into one terminal call that receives both formerly separated evidence windows simultaneously.
structural_mutation.before: A four-call lineage exposes constraints and structural evidence to one executable transition, then exposes task and hypothesis evidence to a separate terminal transition.
structural_mutation.factor: terminal edge contraction into one co-visible non-anchor reentry transition
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation removes one lineage edge and intermediate state boundary, retimes evidence visibility, and transfers both reconciliation actions to one terminal state transition.
